company.name: Novig
company.shortDescription: Novig is a sweepstakes-based sports prediction market in which users participate in peer-to-peer wagering on sporting events.
company.description: Novig is a sports prediction platform where users participate in peer-to-peer wagering on sporting events using dual currencies. It enables participants to propose or accept odds directly with one another, access real-time market data, and engage in prediction markets rather than betting against a traditional house model. Users interact through its mobile app, making selections with free-to-play tokens or staking redeemable tokens for chances to earn cash prizes under a sweepstakes framework. The platform also offers transparent order books and tools for managing wagers, and it supports customer assistance through in-app help and support channels.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile sports prediction-market app where users trade peer-to-peer positions on sporting events using Novig Coins or Novig Cash, with market odds, order-book data, and options to accept or set prices.
productsAndServices.name: Novig Sports Trading App

productsAndServices.description: A web-based tool that converts between fractional, decimal, American, and implied-probability sports odds and calculates potential payouts from a stated stake.

productsAndServices.description: A web-based calculator that removes the bookmaker margin from American odds to estimate normalized, fee-free odds and implied probabilities for a market.
